name: alephscript-mcp-gallery
description: MCPGallery - Ecosistema de servidores MCP para ALEPH Scriptorium

scripts.start:all: npm run start:mesh & npm run start:model & npm run start:zeus
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd mcp-core-sdk && npm install && cd ../mcp-mesh-sdk && npm install && cd ../mcp-model-sdk && npm install && cd ../zeus && npm install
scripts.status: echo 'Checking servers...' && curl -s http://localhost:3003/health 2>/dev/null || echo 'mesh:3003 ❌' && curl -s http://localhost:4001/health 2>/dev/null || echo 'model:4001 ❌' && curl -s http://localhost:3012 2>/dev/null || echo 'zeus:3012 ❌'
scripts.catalog: curl -s http://localhost:4001/ai/ui/mcp/list | jq '.catalog' 2>/dev/null || echo 'Run start:model first'

author: escrivivir-co

zeus.description: UI de gestión de presets MCP
